subject: control refresh of dygraph selector in shiny

messages.author: afee096c4b12165e
messages.subject: control refresh of dygraph selector in shiny
parts:
i have the server.R code below that is working fine to generate a time series plot with a dateRangeSelector.  I have this running locally on two different machines.

On one, when the input$horizon value changes, the plot is refreshed, but the position of the range selector does not go back to its defaults.  On my laptop, every time the input$horizon value is changed in the UI, the range selector resets to the default values.

The first behavior is much preferred, but I don't know why it is acting differently on different machines.

Thanks for any ideas......

Alan


shinyServer(function(input, output) { 
  
    
    filterdata <- subset(pl, counterparty=="ALL" &
                           commodity=="ALL" &
                           trader=="ALL" &
                           region=="ALL" &
                           fwdmonth==9999)
  plt <- reactive({ 
 
    plotone <- filterdata[,c('AsOfDate', c(input$horizon)) ]
    plotone <- rename_(plotone, pl=input$horizon)
    
    
    plt <- xts(plotone[,-1], order.by=as.POSIXct(plotone$AsOfDate))                  
  })
               

    output$stressplot <- renderDygraph({


                                                 
           dygraph(plt()) %>%
                 dySeries('pl', pointSize=5, drawPoints=TRUE, strokeWidth=0.1, color="blue")  %>%
                 dyRangeSelector(dateWindow=c("2012-02-01","2013-02-01"))             
    })
  
})

messages.subject: Re: control refresh of dygraph selector in shiny
parts: We recently added (in the v0.4.5 release that just went to CRAN on Friday) a retainDateWindow option for dyRangeSelector that affects whether the window is retained when the dygraph is re-rendered. Can you compare packageVersion('dygraphs') on the two machines?
